name: Mission
author: vk
description: Your AI agent team, its work and its spend, right in the Omarchy bar. One click opens the team panel: every bot, its state and the task it is on. A second page shows what the team spent today, this week or this month, by bot or by model. Notifications when a bot answers another, the agent app's window one click away, eight languages, one light Rust engine. Works with MausBot.

barWidget.description: The team, its spend and its last turns; middle-click to hide or show the window
